params.message:
Link stamp: an address printed after its title on the same line is found

The stamp looked for a printed address only where it starts a line. A source
list set as sentences, with the address after the title and running on over
the next line, got no links: 8 of the 9 sources of Going to School in
Phone-Free Europe. An address on a line of its own is still taken there first.

Portal: The sources of Going to School in Phone-Free Europe now also lead to their page on gentells.com from the report PDF.
